title: Designer Lighting
desc: Professional-grade fixtures delivering accurate colour & matching hues, custom circadian daylight scenes, and hidden LED strips that keep sightlines clean under cabinets and entryways.

scenarios.result: outdoor and entryway lights automatically turn on.
hallway lights ramp to soft 15% glow to see without glare.
landscape lights illuminate at dusk, dimming to 20% at 11 p.m.

title: Design Without Distraction
desc: Custom-engraved designer keypads with RGB backlighting, replacing wall switch clutter with single touch control for lighting, music, drapes, and climate.

scenarios.result: favourite lounge playlists start & task lights increase to 30%.
hidden TV emerges, lights dim 60%, motorized shades close.
every light turns off, doors lock, and alarm system activates.

title: Architectural Shading
desc: Silent, synchronized motorized shades with fabrics curated to match interior design, protecting paintings and furnishings from UV damage.

scenarios.result: automatically adjusts shades based on time of day or solar levels.
lowers shades automatically when security system is armed.
integrates shades with lighting scenes for total wellness.

title: Invisible Architectural Audio
desc: Commercial-grade speakers fully hidden within ceilings and walls, processing multiple audio sources for whole home music zones without visual impact.

scenarios.result: different rooms stream independent music via hidden speakers.
movie quality acoustics balanced for interior aesthetics.
home theatre surround sound built directly inside walls.

title: User Friendly Security
desc: Discreet cameras, glass break sensors for large windows without visible wiring, access control intercoms, and temperature monitoring.

scenarios.result: doorbell chimes through speakers with video preview on screens & TVs.
notifications if temperature in wine cellar or rack rises.
video intercom with temporary codes for cleaners & contractors.

title: Motorized TV & Media Concealment
desc: Dual-purpose living spaces where high definition displays emerge from VisionArt framed artwork or lift out of custom cabinetry on command.

scenarios.result: displays transform into museum artwork when powered off.
motorized lifts elevate displays out of footboards or credenzas.
